stories.title: Festive vehicle sales hit record high as EVs cross 5 lakh
stories.summary: India sold 5,525,490 vehicles during the 42-day festive season, a record high. Data from the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations shows electric vehicle sales rose 52.62 percent to 509,667 units. Nearly one in ten vehicles sold during the period was electric. A record on top of a record.

stories.title: Passenger vehicle retail sales decline during festive season
stories.summary: Retail sales of passenger vehicles in India fell 7.16 percent during the 2026 festive season compared to the previous year. While overall vehicle sales grew 2.21 percent to 5,525,490 units, passenger vehicle volume dropped to 748,616 units. Electric vehicle sales rose 52.62 percent to cross five lakh units.

Auto suppliers urged to increase R&D spending
stories.summary: Sona Comstar CEO Vivek Vikram Singh says Indian automotive component manufacturers must increase research and development spending beyond 0.5 percent to remain globally competitive. Singh stated that R&D should be a habit across the industry rather than an annual exercise focused on showcasing new products.

stories.title: Brokerage identifies top OEM picks for growth
stories.summary: Nuvama expects domestic passenger vehicle, two-wheeler and commercial vehicle volumes to grow at compound annual growth rates of 11 percent, 7 percent and 7 percent respectively. The firm identifies Tata Motors, Mahindra and Mahindra, Eicher Motors and TVS Motor as likely outperformers in their respective market segments.

stories.title: Capital shifts toward new Indian business sectors
stories.summary: India attracted $72 billion in energy-transition investment in 2025. Capital is increasingly moving into chips, clean power, data centres, electric mobility and defence. Growth is no longer limited to IT services and consumer goods, as digital infrastructure reaches smaller towns and the middle class continues to spend.

stories.title: Honda to unveil Alpha electric SUV in December
stories.summary: Honda has confirmed the name of its first electric SUV for the Indian market is Alpha. The vehicle is scheduled for an official unveiling on 2 December 2026. The company has released teaser images and videos ahead of the launch to provide a glimpse of the front end.

stories.title: Mahindra prepares four new vehicle launches
stories.summary: Mahindra is preparing to launch four models in India by April 2027, including the Thar Roxx, XEV 9e Sporteq, BE 07 and Scorpio Lifestyler. The lineup features a mix of updated SUVs and electric vehicles as the company seeks to strengthen its position in the domestic market.

stories.title: Mahindra to launch 4 new models in India April 2027 - NewsBytes
Nissan Terrano design surfaces in regulatory filings
stories.summary: Images of the production-spec Nissan Terrano have appeared in Chinese regulatory filings. The SUV is based on a body-on-frame platform developed by Nissan partner Dongfeng. The design retains the boxy proportions of the concept model previewed in April 2026, with a global debut expected in early 2027.

stories.title: JSW Motors tests Jaecoo J5 hybrid in India
stories.summary: A strong-hybrid version of the JSW Motors Jaecoo J5-based SUV has been spotted testing on Indian roads. The test mule features design cues from the global model, which is sold in both internal combustion and electric versions. JSW Motors is scheduled for a brand debut on 3 December.

stories.title: New vehicle launches scheduled for December 2026
stories.summary: December 2026 will see several new vehicle arrivals in India, including the Honda Alpha electric SUV, the JSW Combat and a Volkswagen Virtus facelift. Honda's Alpha is expected to be priced between Rs 17 lakh and 22 lakh. Some models are set for unveiling while others begin sales.

stories.title: Honda and JSW prepare for December vehicle debuts
stories.summary: The Indian market expects several new car launches in December 2026. Honda will introduce its first all-electric offering, the Alpha, on 2 December. The month will also see a new brand debut from JSW, which plans to bring a plug-in hybrid vehicle to the market.

Royal Enfield to launch 250cc bikes
stories.summary: Royal Enfield will enter the 250cc segment next fiscal to target buyers moving up from commuter bikes. The manufacturer aims to triple its domestic market share as it shifts focus from its traditional 350cc to 650cc range. The premiumisation wave is apparently coming for the entry-level market.

stories.title: Triumph launches Street Triple 798 RS
stories.summary: Triumph has launched the 2027 Street Triple 798 RS for Rs 14.39 lakh. The updated roadster features a larger engine, redesigned chassis, and wireless smartphone integration. It weighs less than the outgoing 765 RS while retaining the three-cylinder layout. More power is now available for the middleweight segment.

Ultraviolette breaks ground on ₹779 crore Hosur factory, targets 2.5 lakh units annually - ET Auto
Vietnam motorcycle sales rise 24.5 percent
stories.summary: Vietnam's motorcycle market reached 3.38 million units in the first 10 months of 2026. Electric models accounted for 31.9 percent of total sales, up from 22.3 percent in 2025. Electric two-wheelers now represent roughly 70 percent of the industry's total net sales growth.

stories.title: BYD sales cross 3,000 units in Bangladesh
stories.summary: BYD has reached 3,000 electric vehicle sales in Bangladesh, with 2,000 units sold in the last five months. The company currently offers seven models in the country and plans to introduce two more. Buyers are increasingly looking beyond fuel-powered cars due to lower running costs.

stories.title: EU electric car sales beat petrol and diesel combined
stories.summary: The EU registered 279,799 battery-electric cars in October, an increase of 61.4 percent. Combined petrol and diesel sales fell significantly, leaving EVs 70,000 units ahead for the month. Combustion engines remain ahead for the year, but the monthly gap has closed.

stories.title: BYD outsells Tesla in battery-electric vehicles
stories.summary: BYD sold 2,256,714 battery-electric passenger vehicles in 2025, a 27.9 percent increase from the previous year. Tesla delivered 1,636,129 vehicles during the same period, marking an 8.6 percent decline. The figures exclude plug-in hybrids and indicate a shift in the global electric vehicle market.

stories.title: Global EV sales reach 5.79 million in Q3
stories.summary: Global new energy vehicle sales rose 7.6 percent to 5.79 million units in the third quarter of 2026. Battery electric vehicles drove the growth despite a decline in plug-in hybrid sales. Electrified vehicles now account for 35.2 percent of global automotive sales.

stories.title: Chinese brands dominate global EV top 10
stories.summary: Eight of the top 10 selling electric vehicle brands in the third quarter of 2026 were Chinese. Only Tesla and Kia remained in the top tier as Chinese manufacturers captured a combined 43 percent share of the global market. The grip is tightening.

stories.title: PM E-DRIVE scheme supports 2.8 million EVs
stories.summary: The PM E-DRIVE scheme, launched in September 2024, has enabled 2.66 million sales as of June 2026. With an outlay of 11,900 crore, the government aims to expand charging infrastructure and manufacturing. The initiative is currently scheduled to run until March 2028.

stories.title: Kenya's electric mobility market expands
stories.summary: Kenya's electric mobility industry is moving beyond vehicle sales into charging networks, battery assembly, and fleet management. Companies are testing various commercial models to address infrastructure and financing needs. The industry is currently building the support systems required to keep the vehicles running.

stories.title: West Bengal to survey bus routes before adding 435 vehicles to WBTC fleet - ET Auto
Jula Logistics orders 20 more battery-electric trucks from Scania
stories.summary: Jula Logistics has ordered 20 additional battery-electric trucks from Scania, bringing its total order to 40 vehicles for 2027 delivery. The trucks feature a battery pack design behind the cab that Scania claims enables a range of up to 720 km. Testing continues.

stories.title: EEA links electric truck growth to grid and charging needs
stories.summary: The European Environment Agency reports that electric truck sales are rising, though they remain a small share of total registrations. Scaling the sector will require charging infrastructure and electricity grids to keep pace. The agency also suggests shifting freight to rail to cut emissions.

stories.title: Electric truck sales rise as charging infrastructure lags
stories.summary: Registrations of electric medium and heavy trucks in Europe rose 66 percent in 2025, now accounting for 4.2 percent of new sales. Despite the growth, only 3 percent of the main transport network is equipped to charge them. Diesel remains the standard for long-haul routes.

stories.title: BikeWo to invest in Green Drive Mobility
stories.summary: BikeWo Green Tech has approved an investment of approximately 15 crore to acquire a 25 percent stake in Green Drive Mobility. The move is part of a broader plan to deploy a fleet of 10,000 electric two-wheelers and 5,000 electric trucks across India.

stories.title: Boy dies in tractor accident in Buxar
stories.summary: A 12-year-old boy died after falling under a rotavator attached to a tractor during ploughing operations in Bhadar village. Local police have taken custody of the body for a postmortem examination. The boy's father has alleged foul play in the incident.

stories.title: Exponent Energy eyes $500 million revenue target
stories.summary: Exponent Energy projects over $500 million in annual revenue from its battery and charging technology. The target assumes deployment across 5,000 electric buses and 100,000 electric three-wheelers. The company has not provided a timeline for when this deployment might occur.

Leopard released after factory visit
stories.summary: A three-year-old male leopard that wandered into a tractor factory in Punjab was released into the Shivalik foothills on Wednesday. Government veterinarians confirmed the 70 kg animal was free of wounds or disabilities. It was not sent to a zoo.

stories.title: Three arrested for tractor pursuit of elephant
stories.summary: Three men were arrested in Chhattisgarh after using a tractor to harass a wild elephant in a forest habitat. The arrest followed reports of a herd of 11 elephants in the area and a video showing an elephant lifting a tractor. The accused face wildlife protection charges.

stories.title: Boy dies after coming under rotavator in Buxar, kin suspect foul play | Patna News - The Times of India
stories.summary: Buxar: A 12-year-old boy died after coming under a rotavator attached to a tractor while a field was being ploughed at Bhadar village under Sikraul police station area in Buxar district on Thursday. The deceased was identified as Ayush Kumar, son of Yogendra Singh Yadav, a resident of Bhadar village.

Mercedes-Benz plans new China JV for local auto part supplies - ET Auto
Japanese auto parts makers lose global market share
stories.summary: Japanese auto parts manufacturers are losing market share to German and Chinese competitors. The transition to electric vehicles, which require approximately 30 percent fewer parts than internal combustion engines, has contributed to the decline of the Japanese component sector.

stories.title: Toyota to launch extended-range EV in China
stories.summary: Toyota will launch an electric vehicle equipped with a generator in China to compete in the local new energy vehicle market. The move follows a period of declining market share for the Japanese automaker against domestic Chinese rivals.

stories.title: Bosch India gains from stricter regulations
stories.summary: Bosch is seeing increased demand in India as environmental regulations mandate more complex vehicle components. The company's local stock price has risen 35 percent since the start of the year as it provides integrated solutions for diverse powertrain requirements.

stories.title: ZF launches digital toolbox for commercial vehicles
stories.summary: ZF Commercial Vehicle Solutions has introduced a modular Digital Toolbox to support OEMs in their transition to software-defined vehicles. The SaaS offering provides diagnostics, cybersecurity, and over-the-air update management. The company says it helps manufacturers manage increasingly complex software environments. The tools are now available for individual deployment.

stories.title: Shell launches synthetic lubricant range for Indian automotive aftermarket - ET Auto
Digital chassis market projected to grow
stories.summary: The global digital chassis market integrates software, electronic control systems, and intelligent computing platforms to optimize vehicle functions. The sector combines drive-by-wire, brake-by-wire, and centralized control architectures. Industry reports suggest the market is poised for growth as automakers prioritize connectivity and software-defined features in future vehicle designs.

stories.title: Report details electric vehicle battery market landscape
stories.summary: A new report on the global electric vehicle power battery market outlines supplier trends, OEM demand, and emerging battery technologies. The analysis covers competition, regional expansion, and market dynamics through 2026. It aims to provide players with data to navigate the evolving sector and its growth opportunities.

stories.title: O’Reilly reports 12.7 percent sales growth to professional mechanics
stories.summary: O’Reilly Automotive reported a 12.7 percent increase in sales to professional mechanics last quarter, outpacing its do-it-yourself segment. The company attributes its performance to a dense network of stores and hubs, alongside an aging U.S. vehicle fleet. Steady buybacks remain a core part of the business strategy.

Thurlow Nunn invests in Luton dealership
stories.summary: Thurlow Nunn is spending £250,000 to renovate its Luton dealership, including a new seven-car showroom for the Leapmotor electric vehicle brand. The project involves exterior signage and a full repaint, with completion expected by the end of December 2026. The site will continue to house its Vauxhall operations.

stories.title: Honda Motorcycle and Scooter India prioritizes retention
stories.summary: Honda Motorcycle and Scooter India president Tsutsumu Otani says the company is focusing on dealer margins and buyer retention. During the first seven months of fiscal year 2027, the firm dispatched 3.7 million units. The company continues to track its units in operation to maintain its market position.

India retail startups attract 27.6 billion dollars in funding
stories.summary: Ten Indian ecommerce businesses have secured over 27.6 billion dollars in cumulative funding. Flipkart accounts for approximately 15.01 billion dollars of that total. The investment landscape has shifted from building shopping apps to controlling supply chains, distribution networks, and the transaction infrastructure of the country's consumption economy.

Volkswagen accuses Mercedes, BMW, Kia of similar import practices in $1.2 bn tax dispute - ET Auto
Volkswagen contests 1.2 billion dollar tax demand in India
stories.summary: Volkswagen is fighting a 1.2 billion dollar tax demand over allegations that it imported components at a 10 percent tariff before assembling them into cars to evade a 30 percent rate. The company claims the case could wipe out its Indian investments. It currently holds a 2 percent market share.

stories.title: Billionaire Strnad Buys Tesla Supplier Caught in US-China Clash - Bloomberg
Eicher Motors reports 20 percent revenue growth
stories.summary: Eicher Motors reported a 20.3 percent year-on-year revenue increase to 7,422 crore rupees for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. Royal Enfield motorcycle sales reached a record 376,722 units, a 15.2 percent rise. Profit after tax grew 14.9 percent to 1,573 crore rupees compared to last year.

stories.title: Kinetic Engineering reports EV sales growth
stories.summary: Kinetic Engineering reported 7,000 cumulative electric scooter sales and an increase in promoter stake to 65 percent. The company expects its EV business and new auto parts line to each contribute 100 crore rupees to annual revenue. It targets a 5 percent market share by 2030.

stories.title: Tata Motors increases stake in ACGL without new purchases
stories.summary: Tata Motors now holds a 50.17% stake in Automobile Corporation of Goa Limited, up from 48.98%. The increase followed a share buyback by the bus body maker, which automatically elevated Tata Motors to majority shareholder status. The company achieved control without buying a single additional share.

stories.title: Insurers told to brace for credit hire costs rise in 2027
stories.summary: Credit hire costs per claim are expected to rise by an average of 19% next year for cases outside the General Terms of Agreement, according to QG Law. Costs for claims covered by the protocol are also expected to increase by 11% between 2027 and 2029.

stories.title: Automakers increase spending on onboard compute
stories.summary: Mobileye reported an 11% increase in EyeQ chip shipments during the first nine months of 2026, even as global vehicle production fell by 1%. Suppliers including NVIDIA and Qualcomm are reporting record automotive revenue as manufacturers prioritize onboard compute despite building fewer cars overall.

stories.title: MAHLE develops automated charging for electric vehicles
stories.summary: MAHLE has announced an automated charging solution for electric vehicles. The system is designed to allow vehicles to step out, park, and charge without manual intervention. The company is positioning the technology as a step toward autonomous vehicle infrastructure.

stories.title: KPIT opens joint engineering office with Technica Engineering in Wolfsburg - ET Auto
Infineon introduces new radar chip for vehicle sensing
stories.summary: Infineon Technologies has launched the CTRX8144FS, a 76 to 81 GHz radar chip featuring four transmit and four receive channels. The device is designed for front and corner radar applications in centralized vehicle architectures, supporting the industry shift toward software-defined vehicle platforms.

stories.title: Why data, not distance, may determine winners in autonomous driving - Automotive News
Volkswagen launches bi-directional charging in Germany
stories.summary: Volkswagen Group subsidiary Elli has launched a bi-directional charger in Germany. The company claims the unit can offset electricity costs by up to 10,000 miles of motoring per year. A €720 bonus is being offered to owners who sign up during the first contract year.

stories.title: Xpeng says its humanoid robot will cost the same as an EV - Automotive News
XPENG targets 2027 sales for IRON humanoid robot
stories.summary: XPENG unveiled its IRON humanoid robot with plans for mass production in January 2027. The company is targeting public sales in the second quarter of 2027 at a price point comparable to an electric vehicle. It expects revenue from hardware sales and recurring software subscriptions.

stories.title: CAAR proposes vehicle passport to track automotive parts
stories.summary: The Centre of Excellence in Advanced Automotive Research is developing a vehicle passport to track parts from raw material to end of life. The initiative aims to curb the use of fake components, though officials noted success depends on participation across the entire supply chain.

stories.title: Ontario Premier asks B.C. to scrap electric vehicle mandate
stories.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford has requested that British Columbia abandon its zero-emission vehicle sales quota. The appeal follows a directive from B.C. Premier Lorne Doerkson to his environment minister to end the province's sales mandate. The provinces are currently debating the future of these requirements.

stories.title: UK government releases first compliance audit for charging network
stories.summary: The UK Department for Transport has published its first annual enforcement report under the 2018 Automated and Electric Vehicles Act. The findings establish benchmarks for charging infrastructure, including a 99% rapid charger reliability target and requirements for open data publishing and contactless payment access.

stories.title: US lawmakers seek to pass bill restricting Chinese auto parts
stories.summary: The U.S. Congress is attempting to pass the Connected Vehicle Security Act, which would ban the sale of vehicles containing components from adversarial countries including China and Russia. Senators have revised the bill to address industry concerns, aiming for a vote before the end of the year.

stories.title: Industry groups press EU for stricter origin rules
stories.summary: Four European industry associations are urging the EU to require a 75-80% Union-origin threshold for vehicle components within the Industrial Accelerator Act. The groups argue that current proposals are insufficient to restore the competitiveness of the European automotive manufacturing sector.

stories.title: US proposes tariffs on Indian automotive goods
stories.summary: The United States Trade Representative has proposed tariffs of up to 25% on Indian goods, though automotive components currently subject to Section 232 duties are excluded. The U.S. accounted for approximately $6.24 billion of India’s $24 billion in automotive component exports during the 2026 fiscal year.

stories.title: Batteries for low-carbon transport and the electricity grid - UK Parliament
Ontario Premier urges B.C. to scrap EV mandate
stories.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford has written to British Columbia Premier Lorne Doerkson, urging him to scrap the province's electric vehicle sales mandate. Ford claims the policy adds financial pressure to automakers already facing U.S. tariffs. British Columbia has already begun the process of introducing legislation to end the quota.

stories.title: Indian Racing Festival Gears Up for a Three-Day Motorsport and Entertainment Carnival at BIC from November 27 to 29 - Od
Indian Racing Festival returns to Buddh circuit
stories.summary: The Indian Racing Festival will host three days of motorsport and entertainment at the Buddh International Circuit from November 27 to 29. The event features the F4 Indian Championship and the Indian Racing League, alongside drifting displays, vintage car showcases, and live entertainment for spectators at the track.

stories.title: Indian Racing Festival brings motorsport to Noida
stories.summary: The Indian Racing Festival is scheduled for November 27 to 29 at the Buddh International Circuit. The event includes the F4 Indian Championship and the Indian Racing League, featuring demonstrations from Arjuna Awardee Gaurav Gill and drift champion Sanam Sekhon alongside various automotive showcases and live entertainment activities.

stories.title: Hyderabad Blackbirds prepare for Indian Racing League
stories.summary: The Indian Racing Festival returns to the Buddh International Circuit from November 27 to 29. The weekend includes F4 Indian Championship and Indian Racing League racing. Luviwe Sambudla currently leads the F4 standings, with Ntiyiso Mabunda and Aryan Narola remaining as close contenders ahead of the upcoming season finale.

stories.title: Marc Marquez announces MotoGP retirement
stories.summary: Marc Marquez announced his retirement from MotoGP following the final round at Valencia this weekend. The announcement comes five days after he secured his eighth premier class championship. Marquez began his grand prix career in 2008 and claimed his first world title in 2010 at the age of 17.

stories.title: F4 Indian Championship driver Aaron Mehta continues season
stories.summary: Fifteen-year-old Aaron Mehta is competing in the F4 Indian Championship. The driver has experienced a mixed season in the series thus far.

stories.title: Hindustan Zinc and IIT Madras unveil zinc-air battery prototype
stories.summary: Hindustan Zinc and IIT Madras have unveiled an electric three-wheeler prototype featuring a 1 kWh zinc-air battery. The prototype was presented at the IIT Madras Energy Summit 2026 as a range extender for electric mobility, marking a development in the research collaboration between the two institutions.

stories.title: Hindustan Zinc and IIT Madras showcase battery technology
stories.summary: Hindustan Zinc and IIT Madras have unveiled an electric three-wheeler prototype equipped with a 1 kWh zinc-air battery. The project is described as a step toward indigenous and sustainable energy storage solutions. It was presented as a range extender at the recent IIT Madras Energy Summit 2026.

stories.title: VinFast outlines net-zero climate roadmap
stories.summary: VinFast has published a climate roadmap detailing its strategy to reduce emissions as the company grows. The automaker continues to prioritize electric vehicles, focusing on charging infrastructure and service networks in the U.S. and Canada to assist customers with operating costs while addressing broader climate change goals.

stories.title: Research explores battery health tracking for EVs
stories.summary: New research examines methods for estimating the state of health in lithium-ion batteries. Current approaches often rely on complex electrochemical models or data-driven algorithms, each with specific limitations. The study addresses the need for improved tracking to manage driving range, safety, and user confidence in electric vehicles.

stories.title: GAC Aion sales rebound as fleet reliance drops
stories.summary: GAC Aion reported that individual buyers accounted for 81 percent of its vehicle deliveries in 2026. Sales rose 56 percent year-on-year to 327,000 vehicles through October. The company expects full-year retail sales to exceed 400,000 vehicles as it shifts away from its reliance on ride-hailing fleets.

stories.title: XPENG targets overseas sales growth in 2027
stories.summary: XPENG plans to more than double its overseas vehicle sales in 2027. The company intends to introduce five new models internationally, deploy humanoid robots in showrooms, and launch a global robotaxi service. The expansion covers the manufacturer's operations in automobiles, robotics, and autonomous driving technology.

stories.title: MG to end ICE-only car production for China in 2027 - Automotive World
VW China targets top 10 NEV brand status
stories.summary: Volkswagen expects to deliver 32,000 electric cars in China this November. The company aims to become one of the top 10 new energy vehicle brands in the country by 2027. By that time, the company expects these vehicles to account for more than half of its Chinese business.

stories.title: AVATR electric vehicles to launch in Switzerland
stories.summary: The electric vehicle brand AVATR has announced plans to launch in Switzerland in 2027. The company is currently expanding its international presence.

stories.title: Avatr enters the Swiss electric vehicle market
stories.summary: Chinese electric vehicle brand Avatr is expanding into Switzerland following its Paris debut. The company is partnering with Kamps Import AG and Schmohl AG to build a network in the upper segment, with a showroom opening in Zürich in early 2027. The mountains are now electric.

stories.title: Xiaomi sets timeline for European electric vehicle launch
stories.summary: Xiaomi plans to enter the German market in the third quarter of 2027, followed by launches in Sweden, Spain and Italy. The company will conduct functional verification at seven test sites across the four countries. The mobile phone business is currently under pressure.
